verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official SDKs/API clients across nine major languages (JS, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET) plus a REST API and CLI, and community feedback independently praises the developer experience and InstantSearch client libraries across platforms as a standout strength. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of individual SDK quality/coverage beyond JS/React, and no explicit versioning/changelog evidence for each SDK.
